description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed 
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Golgari Rot Farm's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
